items.title: Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. Announces $50 million Stock Repurchase Program
items.summary: Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. the publicly traded holding company of Metropolitan Commercial Bank is pleased to announce that its board of directors has approved a share repurchase plan with authorization to purchase up to fifty million dollars ($50,000,000) of the common stock of the Company (NYSE: MCB)
